name: Companhia Distribuidora de Gás do Rio de Janeiro - CEG
summary: Companhia Distribuidora de Gás do Rio de Janeiro - CEG engages in the distribution of natural gas in Brazil. The company distributes gas through the structuring supply and point-to-point supply systems; and natural gas decompression base. It serves residential and commercial customers; CNG stations; and thermal power generation, electric, and industrial sectors. The company was formerly known as Companhia Estadual de Gás and changed its name to Companhia Distribuidora de Gás do Rio de Janeiro - CEG in 1998.
